title: The Dark corner of the room
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：dark　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dark 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the driver wrote of ① a dark corner of the room in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② darker than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the dark ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the darkest corner of the room anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1972 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too dark to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the dark ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a dark suit for the funeral, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as dark as the suit for the funeral they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was dark or not, and he said so.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something dark, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite dark; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the dark ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988, for the whole place, she wrote of another dark corner of the room in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ darker than anybody had expected. ⑩ The darkest suit for the funeral in the whole station, she said in 1990, was the one she could never quite name; the dark ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 黑暗（前置定语 a dark corner of the room：1978 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件黑暗的角落）
B. adj. 黑暗／深色（比较级 darker than：文中两处，一处比屋里的角落，一处比预想）
C. adj. 黑暗／深色（最高级 the darkest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 黑暗（表语 too dark to do：母亲觉得它太黑暗，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 深色（前置定语 a dark suit for the funeral：叔叔把整件事称作一桩深色的西装）
F. adj. 深色（同级比较 as dark as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩葬礼上穿的西装相比）
G. adj. 深色（后置定语 something dark：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 深色（受程度副词修饰 quite dark：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a dark corner of the room
the darkest corner of the room anybody
a dark suit for the funeral
The darkest suit for the funeral in

answers.why: dark 意为“黑暗”，1978 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件黑暗的角落”，此处作前置定语 a dark corner of the room。
dark 意为“黑暗”，此处用比较级 darker than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
dark 意为“黑暗”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说它是车站里最黑暗的一件，故用最高级 the darkest corner of the room。
dark 意为“黑暗”，母亲认为这件东西“太黑暗了，谁也用不上”，too dark to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
dark 意为“深色”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩深色的西装”，此处作前置定语 a dark suit for the funeral。
dark 意为“深色”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩葬礼上穿的西装一样深色”，同级比较用 as dark as。
dark 意为“深色”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“深色的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something dark。
dark 意为“深色”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当深色”，quite 修饰原级 dark。
dark 意为“深色”，1988 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要深色”，故用比较级 darker than。
dark 意为“深色”，母亲 1990 年说的是“整个车站里最深色的那一桩”，故用最高级 the darkest suit for the funeral。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件黑暗的角落。（a dark corner of the room）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更黑暗。（darker than …）
母亲觉得它太黑暗，谁也用不上。（too dark to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩深色的西装。（a dark suit for the funeral）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩葬礼上穿的西装一样深色。（as dark as …）
到了 1985 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件深色的东西。（something dark）
answers: In 1978 the driver wrote of a dark corner of the room in the timetable.
Everybody said it was darker than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too dark to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a dark suit for the funeral.
He said nobody would call it as dark as the suit for the funeral they had once had.
By 1985 the timetable asked for nothing but something dark.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 dark 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the driver wrote of a dark corner of the room in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the darkest corner of the room in the station, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too dark to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a dark suit for the funeral, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite dark, and everybody laughed.
The dark ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
